body:
PR #2917 Round-2 rework (F2) is complete and pushed without force to origin/claude/story-1889-hold-r2 at 82b90b8af07cff379a5b56acfb8d1e674a8052e1.

Changes:
- Added apply_recusal_route_proposal, write_marker_with_route, and reconcile_recusal_hold_with in protected aida-cli-lib/src/gate/merge_hold_core.rs.
- Both write_marker and reconcile_recusal_hold invoke the unprotected routing helper on a cloned proposal and copy back only routed_to and routing_state into primary.recusal and absorbed[*].recusal (for HoldReasonKind::Recusal entries with existing recusal blocks), validating each via validate_recusal before persisting.
- Added adversarial unit test routing_proposal_boundary_cannot_mutate_non_routing_fields_at_persistence in aida-cli-lib/src/gate/tests/merge_hold_core_tests.rs verifying that tampering with primary, absorbed,placed_at, legacy_detail, principal, reason, or trigger_ref inside the routing callback is ignored at both write_marker and reconcile_recusal_hold.
- Refusal-string inventory unchanged (958 on origin/main -> 957 on branch, only the test-helper panic string moved out of production scan).
- Verification: 98/98 merge_hold unit tests + 34/34 make check-ci-fast gates green.
subject: PR-2917 F2 rework pushed at 82b90b8af07cff379a5b56acfb8d1e674a8052e1 (Refs STORY-1889)
